title: Execute audited Search component polish
description: Implement Search audit findings after modularization, including icon/clear anatomy, containment, debounce/apply behavior, and field-target clarity.
objective: Make Search a first-class filter component instead of a plain text input.
expected_outputs: Mechanical implementation commit 05456ca adds a wrapped Search field with icon, accessible clear button, and containment-safe CSS anatomy
Search auto-apply now supports a clamped debounce setting that is preserved in widget runtime config and filter presets
Search has its own Elementor Style section for icon, clear button, and focus ring variables
Editor cadence tracks Search as a distinct style family so Search styles can hide when no Search filter exists
Search remains keyless by default and keeps the visible-text/title fallback source contract
acceptance_criteria: Search does not overflow its assigned layout width.
Search can explain what field/source it filters.
Clear behavior does not reset unrelated filters unless explicitly designed.
verification: php -l passes for touched PHP files.
node --check passes for assets/js/eit-frontend.js and assets/js/eit-editor.js.

docker compose run --rm wpcli eval-file wp-content/plugins/elementor-implementation-toolkit/scripts/verify-filter-controller-robustness.php passes with 63 passed, 0 failed, and 7 Guilherme-owned visual QA skips.
TEST-FC-ROBUSTNESS-011 remains human-QA-gated for icon, clear button, focus state, and typing feel.

budgets.context_budget: Search audit, render, resolver, JS runtime
budgets.validation_budget: mechanical checks plus punctual visual QA

risks: A good-looking search field can still filter the wrong surface if source binding is vague.
